_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd scpsl/dedicated/egg-s-c-p--s-l.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail runs it on its SteamCMD image (upstream used a Mono image; LocalAdmin is a self-contained .NET program and the game a Unity Linux build), starts LocalAdmin with --useDefault (no config questions on the first start), --noSetCursor and --noTerminalTitle (no cursor or title escapes in the panel console), answers the terminal's cursor queries (tty_answers) and strips colour codes from the saved log. The EULA is the owner's call: the Accept EULA setting (LocalAdmin's ACCEPT_SCPSL_EULA) is FALSE until they set it, and LocalAdmin otherwise asks in the console. While the panel setting server_tools.auto_accept_eula is on, the panel sets it to TRUE (features.eula_variable). The server name and max players are written into the port's config_gameplay.txt by the start line once the game has made that file (from the second start on). Broadcasts (restart warnings, schedules) use the game's bc command for 10 seconds. The stop is LocalAdmin's exit, the start also counts once the game port (UDP) is bound, install sandbox defaults and resource hints, and the install fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: SCP: Secret Laboratory
author: eggs@goover.dev
description: SCP: Secret Laboratory is a multiplayer horror game set in the SCP universe: escape the facility, or hunt those who try. This is the Linux dedicated server, run by LocalAdmin.
startup: CFG="$HOME/.config/SCP Secret Laboratory/config/{{SERVER_PORT}}/config_gameplay.txt"; if [ -f "$CFG" ]; then sed -i -e "s|^server_name:.*|server_name: {{SERVER_NAME}}|" -e "s|^max_players:.*|max_players: {{MAX_PLAYERS}}|" "$CFG"; else echo "Octail: the game writes its config on this first start; the server name and max players apply from the next start."; fi; ./LocalAdmin {{SERVER_PORT}} --useDefault --noSetCursor --noTerminalTitle

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SteamCMD installation script (Octail)
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Variables: SRCDS_APPID (the app), SRCDS_BETAID / SRCDS_BETAPASS (a beta branch), anonymous login.

## anonymous login: these servers need no Steam account
STEAM_USER=anonymous
STEAM_PASS=""
STEAM_AUTH=""

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/LocalAdmin" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the SCP: Secret Laboratory dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x "/mnt/server/LocalAdmin"

## LocalAdmin and the game keep their configs in ~/.config/SCP Secret Laboratory
chmod +x /mnt/server/SCPSL.x86_64 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.config

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server list (Unity rich text such as <color=red>…</color> works; no |, & or \).

variables.name: Accept EULA
variables.description: TRUE accepts the SCP: Secret Laboratory EULA (https://link.scpslgame.com/eula) for this server; with FALSE LocalAdmin asks in the console at the first start.

variables.name: Steam Branch
variables.description: Optional: a public beta branch of the dedicated server. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server at every start.
